name: Beyond the Slime
summary: Beyond the Slime is a real-time tactical roguelike with pause in a medieval fantasy world. It is inspired by FTL. The player leads a caravan of wagons, and each wagon is a room with its own job. The crew mans posts and repairs damage. It can also board enemy wagons. Each run crosses a series of disc-shaped worlds. A spreading slime horde forces battles against monsters and rival caravans.
